verified_facts.text: The resort has a view of the Arenal Volcano and natural hot springs.
verified_facts.excerpt: With a spectacular view of the Arenal Volcano, natural hot springs, five unique dining experiences, and an impressive full-service Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort is in La Fortuna, Costa Rica, directly north of the Arenal Volcano.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Fortuna, Costa Rica, directly north of the Arenal Volcano

verified_facts.text: Every guest room, suite and villa has a private terrace or balcony with a view of the volcano.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each Guest Room, Suite, and Villa at The Springs Resort & Spa includes a Private Terrace and/or Balcony to enjoy our famous, picturesque view of the Volcano.

verified_facts.text: Rooms are equipped with hammocks, rocking chairs, minibars and marble bathrooms with Jacuzzi tubs.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms are equipped with Hammocks, Rocking Chairs, Minibars and Luxurious Marbled Bathrooms with Jacuzzi Tubs.

verified_facts.text: The Honeymoon Vista Guest Room has a garden terrace with a private hot spring-fed Jacuzzi.
verified_facts.excerpt: This unique First-Floor room type features a garden terrace with a Private Hot Spring-Fed Jacuzzi

verified_facts.text: Villa Palacio has a 12-person Jacuzzi with a 360-degree infinity edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: 12 Person Jacuzzi with a 360º Infinity Border

verified_facts.text: The Sanctuary Spa uses the resort's own thermal mineral springs in its therapies.
verified_facts.excerpt: At The Sanctuary Spa we take these natural gifts from our own thermal mineral springs and offer them to our guests through therapies designed to enhance beauty, energy, vitality and balance.

verified_facts.text: The Sanctuary Spa takes up one entire level of the reception building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our fourteen thousand square foot full service luxury Spa encompasses one entire level of our reception building

verified_facts.text: Las Hojas Spa Bungalow is in a river canyon surrounded by several hot springs and creeks.
verified_facts.excerpt: You will enter a heavenly river canyon surrounded by several hot springs and creeks.

verified_facts.text: The water in the hydrothermal pools rises naturally from volcanic magma far below ground.
verified_facts.excerpt: The water in our artesian, hydrothermal pools emerges naturally from volcanic magma thousands of feet below

verified_facts.text: The gym's cardio room has a view of the volcano and the surrounding valley.
verified_facts.excerpt: To enhance your workout experience the cardio room features an inspirational view of the volcano and surrounding valley.

verified_facts.text: La Laguna is a swim-up bar in the center of the largest lagoon pool, which has infinity-edge waterfalls facing the volcano.
verified_facts.excerpt: This central pool is surrounded by lush landscaping and has infinity edge waterfalls fronting the volcano and multiple waterfalls.

verified_facts.text: Los Perdidos is a palm-thatch jungle bar in Perdido Springs, surrounded by hot spring waterfalls on three sides.
verified_facts.excerpt: Los Perdidos is a rustic palm thatch jungle bar that is surrounded by hot spring waterfalls on three sides and rainforest on the other.

verified_facts.text: Hot springs, pools and waterfalls are spread across the property, some tucked into the jungle and others connected to a swim-up bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: some tucked away in the jungle, others connected to a swim-up bar

verified_facts.text: Further down the hill are more hot springs with a water slide.
verified_facts.excerpt: then heading down the hill to discover 7 more hot springs with a water slide

verified_facts.text: Club Rio Outdoor Center sits below the resort along a forested mile-long stretch of Arenal River frontage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club Rio Outdoor Center is located directly below the resort along our beautifully forested, mile long stretch of Arenal River frontage.

verified_facts.text: Club Rio offers river tubing, river kayaking, horseback riding, a climbing and rappelling wall, an animal sanctuary, guided nature hikes, fishing and hot springs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Club Rio Outdoor Center offers River Tubing, River Kayaking, Horseback Riding, Climbing and Rappelling Wall, Animal Sanctuary, Guided Nature Hikes, Fishing and Hot Springs.

verified_facts.text: With the Ministry of Environment and Energy, the resort runs a preserve for Costa Rican wildlife confiscated from poachers or donated by reserves, rescue centers or individuals.
verified_facts.excerpt: In conjunction with the MINAE (Ministry of Environment and Energy) we operate a preserve for Costa Rican wildlife that have been confiscated from poachers or donated by other private reserves, rescue centers or individuals.

verified_facts.text: The sanctuary cares for wildlife including jungle cats, monkeys and sloths.
verified_facts.excerpt: We currently care for an assortment of wildlife including jungle cats, monkeys, sloths, and more!

verified_facts.text: The horseback ride crosses the Arenal River and gallops through mountain meadows facing the Arenal Volcano.
verified_facts.excerpt: this ride combines scenic forest trails, a crossing through the Arenal River and a gallop in the mountain meadows fronting the magnificent Arenal Volcano.

verified_facts.text: River tubing runs down Class I and II rapids on the Arenal River.
verified_facts.excerpt: Prepare yourself for a thrilling ride down Class I and II rapids on the incredibly scenic Arenal River

verified_facts.text: A guided night walk through the jungle looks for tree frogs, scorpions and two-toed sloths.
verified_facts.excerpt: go on the guided night walk tour through the jungle to see tree frogs, scorpions, and two-toed sloths

verified_facts.text: Everything at the hotel is built on-site, with property warehouses for woodworking, welding and natural stonework.
verified_facts.excerpt: Everything at the hotel is built on-site—there are warehouses on the property for woodworking, welding, natural stonework, and more

verified_facts.text: La Casita de las Flores is the resort's on-site floral studio, where arrangements are made daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: to see fresh arrangements being made daily with great artistic care and detail

verified_facts.text: The chef uses organic fruits and vegetables grown for the resort on neighboring farms.
verified_facts.excerpt: organic fruits and vegetables grown specifically for us on neighboring farms

verified_facts.text: The resort has five restaurants and six bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: Two Day Pass to the Hot Springs, Pools and our Five Restaurants and Six Bars

verified_facts.text: Club Rio is about a mile from the main lobby, with shuttles every half hour.
verified_facts.excerpt: located one mile from the main lobby with shuttles running back and forth every half hour

verified_facts.text: Club Rio has no lifeguards or babysitters.
verified_facts.excerpt: We do not have lifeguards or babysitters and we cannot be responsible for the supervision or disciplining of your children.

verified_facts.text: Room rates do not include breakfast or other meals.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rates DO NOT include breakfast, any other meals, or sales tax (13%).

verified_facts.text: Lodging includes unlimited access to all hot springs and pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lodging includes unlimited access to all Hot Springs and Pools.

verified_facts.text: The mineral-rich hot spring water may stain swimwear, so a dark, inexpensive bathing suit is recommended.
verified_facts.excerpt: OUR HOT SPRINGS WATER IS RICH WITH MINERALS AND IT MIGHT STAIN YOUR BATHING SUIT

verified_facts.text: Complimentary golf cart service runs throughout the property around the clock.
verified_facts.excerpt: complimentary golf cart service is available throughout the property 24/7

verified_facts.text: Off-property excursions such as ATV tours, zip-lining and guided volcano hikes can be arranged.
verified_facts.excerpt: Off-property excursions can also be arranged, such as ATV tours, zip-lining, and guided hikes of the volcano itself.
